commands.command: cargo clippy --workspace --lib --bins --examples --all-features -- -D warnings -D unsafe_code -D clippy::unwrap_used -D clippy::expect_used -D clippy::panic -D clippy::panic_in_result_fn -D clippy::todo -D clippy::unimplemented -D clippy::dbg_macro -D clippy::indexing_slicing -D clippy::string_slice -D clippy::get_unwrap -D clippy::arithmetic_side_effects -D clippy::as_conversions -D clippy::let_underscore_must_use -D clippy::await_holding_lock

rules_satisfied: No lossy as conversions - replaced payload.len() as u32 with u32::try_from(payload.len())
No unchecked arithmetic - used checked_add for capacity computation
No Vec::with_capacity without fallible reserve - uses Vec::new + try_reserve
Payload bounded by max_payload with FrameError::PayloadTooLarge
Overflow protected via checked_add returning FrameError::Overflow
Allocation bounded via try_reserve returning FrameError::Allocation
Frame encoder contains both checked_add and try_reserve per mandatory pattern
Zero clippy warnings under strict lint flags
No production assertions or unreachable macros
residual_risk: None. All Holzman absolute laws satisfied. Frame encoder pattern fully implemented with checked_add, try_reserve, u32::try_from, and PayloadTooLarge bound. Tests pass, clippy clean, no formatting drift.
